text:
Protocol v3.2 (Amendment A1) at 1b8c67a52b68b9513ae193b360865d62b565ee62 records the owner's v0b decisions.
- GLMsingle type-B parity is now checked against a float32-derived bound relative to a float64 fit of the same model; the original literal 1e-6 FAIL is retained.
- TR-aligned onsets are used in GLMsingle-scored cells (T-G = T-TX cells), applied to all arms.
- Type-D shrinkage and the noise-pool selection are disclosed.
- Measured GLMsingle runtime of 10-22 core-s per fit cuts the campaign GLMsingle cost from ~105 to ~3 core-h.
- New pilot estimate: central ~22 / upper ~50 core-h. The cap is LOWERED from the owner-approved 85 to 60 (more conservative, within authority).
- D8a: ~450 core-h at D=42 and ~575 at D=55 (was 595/760).
- v0 gates: v0a TX PASS (independently reviewed, follow-up 9c8ae263). v0b GLMsingle amended parity PASS at 9b943c4f (margins 62x/14.5x/5.2x; negative controls 175-4859x over the bound); independent review in progress.
